## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->

The new-work-skills repository provides a curated set of Agent Skills that describe how to apply the New Work with Skills methodology. It includes a flat‑structured skills folder, detailed level descriptions, and reference materials that guide users from beginner concepts to advanced patterns such as role‑as‑skill and test‑driven skill workflows. The framework helps individuals and teams capture, organize, and continuously improve their work by using skills as reusable knowledge units. Developers, knowledge workers, and anyone interested in skill‑driven productivity can clone the repo, read the level guide, and start creating or extending skills in their own projects.
